angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 243,495 km at 115.20 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.6807 +/- 0.0373 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 115.20 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.35 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Kagetani et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-519 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract): 243,495 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.335 +/- 0.008 solar masses from Kagetani et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-519 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3322 +/- 49 K from Kagetani et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-519 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Kagetani et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-519 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-519.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.875, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-519 (pscomppars): spectral type M V, from Kagetani et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-519 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.27 dex, from Kagetani et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-519 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.85078, from Kagetani et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-519 (pscomppars): age 5.4 Gyr, from Kagetani et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75..713K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/MNRAS/520/5283/table1 (Rotation periods and ages of cool host stars), column Prot: 84.3 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place
